合并目标分支已变化，请刷新并重新确认目标: The merge target branch changed. Refresh and confirm the target again.
GitLab 合并条件尚未满足，请刷新检查结果: GitLab's merge requirements have not been met. Refresh the checks.
所选 Squash 选项与 GitLab 项目策略不一致: The selected squash option does not match the GitLab project policy.
GitLab 项目要求删除源分支，请确认该选项: The GitLab project requires source branch deletion. Confirm this option.
当前未确认删除源分支的权限，请在 GitLab 核对: Permission to delete the source branch has not been confirmed. Check it in GitLab.
GitLab 已确认合并完成: GitLab confirmed that the merge is complete.
GitLab 已接收请求，正在确认合并结果: GitLab accepted the request; the merge result is being confirmed.
已重新查询 GitLab，合并已完成: GitLab was checked again and confirms that the merge is complete.
合并结果尚未确认；请刷新状态或在 GitLab 核对，请勿重复提交: The merge result is not confirmed. Refresh the status or check GitLab; do not submit it again.
GitLab 完整读取超时，保留上次完整结果: The complete GitLab read timed out. The previous complete results were kept.
仓库或账号已切换，请重新打开合并请求: The repository or account changed. Reopen the merge request.
尚未配置 GitLab 合并请求: GitLab merge requests have not been configured.
合并请求检查暂时暂停: Merge request checks are temporarily paused.
合并请求数量超过本地缓存上限，未替换原完整列表，请在 GitLab 查看: The merge request count exceeded the local cache limit. The previous complete list was kept; review it in GitLab.
检查结果所属仓库或账号已改变: The repository or account for these check results changed.
等待首次完整合并请求检查完成: Wait for the first complete merge request check to finish.
详情所属仓库或账号已改变: The repository or account for these details changed.
该 GitLab 账号认证已失效，请更新凭据: Authentication for this GitLab account has expired. Update its credentials.
当前 GitLab 项目权限不足，请检查访问权限: Permissions for this GitLab project are insufficient. Check your access.
此合并请求不在当前列表: This merge request is not in the current list.
差异所属仓库或账号已改变: The repository or account for this diff changed.
讨论所属仓库或账号已改变: The repository or account for these discussions changed.
已有合并操作正在进行，请等待结果: A merge operation is already in progress. Wait for the result.
请先查看并确认本次提交差异: Review and confirm the diff for this revision first.
合并操作结果尚未确认，请到 GitLab 核实，勿重复提交: The merge result is not confirmed. Check GitLab and do not submit it again.
操作已发送，但应用状态已变化，请到原 GitLab 项目核实结果，勿重复提交: The operation was sent, but the app state changed. Check the original GitLab project and do not submit it again.
合并操作结果尚未确认，请刷新状态或到 GitLab 核实，勿直接重复提交: The merge result is not confirmed. Refresh the status or check GitLab before taking any further action.
尚未加载合并请求: The merge request has not been loaded yet.
完整合并请求摘要超过本地缓存上限，保留上次完整列表，请在 GitLab 查看: The complete merge request summary exceeds the local cache limit. The last complete list is kept; view it in GitLab.
完整详情超过本地缓存预算，请在 GitLab 查看: The complete details exceed the local cache budget. View them in GitLab.
远程差异版本或比较范围已变化，请刷新并重新审阅: The remote diff version or comparison range has changed. Refresh and review it again.
